exposure: Maternal HAART use (duration and timing of initiation)
outcome: Infant HIV status (PCR-DNA test at six weeks)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 65 pairs of HIV-seropositive mothers on HAART and their formula-fed babies.
finding: The overall mother-to-child HIV transmission rate was 1.5% among formula-fed infants of mothers on HAART.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant association between the baby's HIV PCR-DNA status at six weeks and the mode of delivery.
